q_gram_c2_01_001.question: A mí ___ que no tienen razón. (parecer, stylistic inversion cho emphasis)
q_gram_c2_01_001.explanation: trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha, fronting  indirect object pronoun with 'a mí' creates emphasis on  speaker's opinion.  verb 'parecer' agrees with  implied subject ( clause 'que no tienen razón'), taking third-person số ít: 'me parece'.
q_gram_c2_01_001.hint: subject của 'parecer' is  entire clause mà follows, not 'yo'

q_gram_c2_01_002.question: Fue en París ___ nos conocimos por primera vez. (cleft sentence particle)
q_gram_c2_01_002.explanation: This is a cleft sentence (oración hendida) used cho emphasis: 'Fue en París donde...' emphasizes  location. When  focused element is a place, 'donde' được sử dụng. If it were a time, 'cuando' would be used; cho other elements, 'que' is more common. Some speakers accept 'que' here too, but 'donde' is  stylistically precise choice.
q_gram_c2_01_002.hint: focused element is a place (en París)

q_gram_c2_01_003.question: What stylistic effect does placing  verb before  subject produce trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha declarative sentences (e.g., 'Llegó Juan' vs. 'Juan llegó')?
q_gram_c2_01_003.correct: It presents the subject as new or unexpected information (rhematic focus), giving the sentence a more narrative or dramatic tone
wrong: It makes the sentence grammatically more formal but has no change in meaning
It indicates that the action is habitual rather than a single event
It transforms the sentence into a question in formal registers
q_gram_c2_01_003.explanation: trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha,  default word order SVO can be altered cho information-structural purposes. Verb-Subject order (VS) places  subject trong rhematic (new information) position: 'Llegó Juan' presents Juan's arrival as noteworthy hoặc unexpected, whereas 'Juan llegó' treats Juan as already known (thematic). This VS order is common trong literary và journalistic prose cho dramatic effect.

q_gram_c2_01_004.question: Lo que ___ es una explicación clara, no excusas. (necesitar, present indicative, nosotros — emphatic pseudocleft)
q_gram_c2_01_004.explanation: trong a pseudocleft (oración pseudohendida) like 'Lo que necesitamos es...',  verb trong  relative clause takes  indicative vì it refers để a real, asserted need.  subjunctive would be used only if  need were hypothetical hoặc uncertain, mà  emphatic tone của  pseudocleft denies.
q_gram_c2_01_004.conjugation_info: necesitar (present indicative): necesito, necesitas, necesita, necesitamos, necesitáis, necesitan

q_gram_c2_01_005.question: Bonita respuesta ___ diste. (emphatic ironic construction with determiner)
q_gram_c2_01_005.explanation: construction 'Bonita respuesta la que me diste' uses fronted predicative adjective + noun followed by a relative clause introduced by 'la que', creating an ironic hoặc sarcastic emphasis. This stylistic pattern is characteristic của colloquial yet rhetorically effective Spanish, implying  response was anything but 'bonita'.
q_gram_c2_01_005.hint: ironic construction uses a mạo từ xác định + 'que' để introduce  relative clause

q_gram_c2_01_006.question: Hubiera sido mejor que ___ la verdad desde el principio. (decir, pluperfect subjunctive, tú — formal literary register)
q_gram_c2_01_006.explanation: After 'hubiera sido mejor que',  pluperfect subjunctive is needed để express a counterfactual past situation with a literary hoặc formal tone. 'Hubieras dicho' uses hubiera +  irregular past participle 'dicho'.  alternative 'dijeras' (imperfect subjunctive) would shift  có nghĩa là để an unrealized present/general wish rather than a regretted past action.
q_gram_c2_01_006.conjugation_info: decir (pluperfect subjunctive): hubiera dicho, hubieras dicho, hubiera dicho, hubiéramos dicho, hubierais dicho, hubieran dicho

q_gram_c2_01_007.question: De haber ___ la verdad, todo habría sido diferente. (saber, infinitive compound — literary concise style)
q_gram_c2_01_007.explanation: 'De + haber + past participle' is a compact literary alternative để 'si hubiera/hubiese + past participle' cho expressing counterfactual conditions. 'De haber sabido' = 'Si hubiera sabido' (If I had known). This construction is favored trong elevated written registers cho its conciseness và elegance.
q_gram_c2_01_007.hint: This construction replaces 'si + pluperfect subjunctive' with 'de + compound infinitive'

q_gram_c2_01_008.question: It was precisely his arrogance that led to his downfall.
q_gram_c2_01_008.correct: Fue precisamente su arrogancia lo que provocó su caída.
wrong: Fue precisamente su arrogancia que provocó su caída.
Era precisamente su arrogancia la que provocaba su caída.
Precisamente su arrogancia fue que provocó su caída.
q_gram_c2_01_008.explanation: This is a cleft sentence (oración hendida) focusing on 'su arrogancia'. Since  focused element is an abstract concept rather than a specific gendered noun functioning as subject của  relative,  neuter 'lo que' được sử dụng (not 'la que').  preterite 'fue...provocó' indicates a completed past event. Omitting 'lo' before 'que' is a common error.

q_gram_c2_01_009.question: Cuanto más se ___ en el tema, más complejo le parecía. (adentrar, imperfect subjunctive, él — literary concessive escalation)
q_gram_c2_01_009.explanation: 'Cuanto más...más...' with  imperfect subjunctive trong literary register creates a correlative escalation structure. While 'adentraba' (indicative) would be acceptable trong everyday Spanish,  subjunctive 'adentrara' adds a layer của subjective perception consistent with 'le parecía'. Note: 'adentrase' (-se form) is technically also correct but  -ra form is expected here.
q_gram_c2_01_009.conjugation_info: adentrarse (imperfect subjunctive): me adentrara, te adentraras, se adentrara, nos adentráramos, os adentrarais, se adentraran

q_gram_c2_01_010.question: No es que no quiera ayudarte; es que no puedo.
q_gram_c2_01_010.correct: It's not that I don't want to help you; it's that I can't.
wrong: It's not that I can't help you; it's that I don't want to.
I neither want to help you nor am I able to.
The reason is not that I want to help you; it's that I can.
q_gram_c2_01_010.explanation: 'No es que + subjunctive' (no quiera) negates one possible interpretation while 'es que + indicative' (no puedo) asserts  real reason. This contrastive focus structure is a hallmark của nuanced Spanish argumentation, using  subjunctive để deny và  indicative để affirm.  stylistic effect is diplomatic self-justification.

q_gram_c2_02_001.question: Si así lo ___, que Dios se lo demande. (hacer, future subjunctive, él — archaic legal/religious formula)
q_gram_c2_02_001.explanation: future subjunctive ('hiciere') survives trong legal documents, religious oaths, và proverbs. From  irregular preterite stem hic-,  future subjunctive adds -iere. trong modern everyday Spanish, this would be 'si lo hace' hoặc 'si lo hiciera'.
q_gram_c2_02_001.conjugation_info: hacer (future subjunctive): hiciere, hicieres, hiciere, hiciéremos, hiciereis, hicieren

q_gram_c2_02_002.question: Apenas hubo ___ el rey, toda la corte enmudeció. (entrar, pretérito anterior — literary narrative)
q_gram_c2_02_002.explanation: pretérito anterior ('hubo entrado') được sử dụng trong literary prose after temporal conjunctions like 'apenas' (scarcely) để indicate an action completed immediately before another past event. This tense is virtually extinct trong spoken Spanish but appears trong formal và literary writing.  past participle của 'entrar' is regular: 'entrado'.

q_gram_c2_02_003.question: Sea lo que ___, no me rendiré. (ser, future subjunctive — archaic concessive formula)
q_gram_c2_02_003.explanation: expression 'sea lo que fuere' (come what may) preserves  future subjunctive 'fuere' trong a fixed concessive formula. trong modern Spanish, this is often regularized để 'sea lo que sea', but  archaic form persists trong formal và literary registers.  future subjunctive của 'ser' shares forms with 'ir': fuere, fueres, fuere, etc.

q_gram_c2_02_004.question: What is  'pretérito anterior' (hubo cantado) và why is it considered archaic?
q_gram_c2_02_004.correct: A compound past tense formed with the preterite of 'haber' + past participle, expressing immediate anteriority; it has been replaced by the simple preterite or pluperfect in all but literary usage
wrong: A simple past tense formed by adding special archaic endings to the verb stem, still common in legal texts
A conditional perfect tense that was used before the modern conditional emerged in the 16th century
A pluperfect indicative variant using 'ser' instead of 'haber' as the auxiliary, common until the 18th century
q_gram_c2_02_004.explanation: pretérito anterior (hube cantado, hubiste cantado, hubo cantado, etc.) expresses an action completed immediately before another past action. It appeared after temporal conjunctions like 'apenas', 'en cuanto', 'no bien'. It has been almost entirely replaced by  simple preterite hoặc  pluperfect (había cantado) trong modern Spanish, surviving only trong very formal literary prose.

q_gram_c2_02_005.question: Donde ___ necesidad, acuda el ciudadano al servicio público. (haber, future subjunctive, archaic legal register)
q_gram_c2_02_005.explanation: trong legal và administrative Spanish,  future subjunctive 'hubiere' được sử dụng trong conditional hoặc relative clauses referring để hypothetical future situations. 'Donde hubiere necesidad' có nghĩa là 'wherever there may be need'. Modern non-legal Spanish would use 'donde haya necesidad'.
q_gram_c2_02_005.conjugation_info: haber (future subjunctive): hubiere, hubieres, hubiere, hubiéremos, hubiereis, hubieren

q_gram_c2_02_006.question: Pluguiera a Dios que ___ paz en el mundo. (haber — archaic optative construction)
q_gram_c2_02_006.explanation: 'Pluguiera a Dios' (would mà it pleased God) is an archaic optative expression using  imperfect subjunctive của 'placer' (pluguiera).  following clause also takes  subjunctive: 'hubiera paz'. trong modern Spanish, this would be 'ojalá hubiera paz'.  verb 'placer' had  irregular form 'plugo' (preterite) from mà 'pluguiera' derives.
q_gram_c2_02_006.hint: 'Pluguiera' is  archaic imperfect subjunctive của 'placer' (để please)

q_gram_c2_02_007.question: Whoever shall commit this offense will be punished according to the law.
q_gram_c2_02_007.correct: Quien cometiere esta falta será castigado conforme a la ley.
wrong: Quien cometa esta falta será castigado conforme a la ley.
Quien cometería esta falta sería castigado conforme a la ley.
Quien haya cometido esta falta ha sido castigado conforme a la ley.
q_gram_c2_02_007.explanation: trong legal Spanish, 'quien + future subjunctive' (cometiere) được sử dụng cho hypothetical future agents trong statutory provisions. This parallels  archaic English 'whoever shall commit'. While 'cometa' (present subjunctive) is acceptable trong modern legal drafting,  future subjunctive remains  traditional form trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha jurisprudence.

q_gram_c2_02_008.question: No bien hubo ___ la sentencia, el acusado se desplomó. (oír, pretérito anterior — literary narrative)
q_gram_c2_02_008.explanation: After 'no bien' (no sooner),  pretérito anterior ('hubo oído') expresses an action completed immediately before another past event.  past participle của 'oír' is 'oído' (with an accent để break  diphthong). This tense is reserved cho highly formal literary narrative.
q_gram_c2_02_008.hint: past participle của 'oír' has an accent mark

q_gram_c2_02_009.question: Adonde fueres, haz lo que vieres.
q_gram_c2_02_009.correct: Wherever you may go, do as you may see (done). / When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
wrong: Wherever you went, do what you saw there.
Go where you want and do what you want.
Where you will go, see what you will do.
q_gram_c2_02_009.explanation: This famous proverb preserves  future subjunctive ('fueres' from ir, 'vieres' from ver) trong a conditional-concessive structure. nó là  Spanish equivalent của 'When trong Rome, do as  Romans do'.  future subjunctive here expresses hypothetical, open-ended future situations trong a timeless proverbial way. This form has been replaced by  present subjunctive hoặc indicative trong all non-proverbial modern usage.

q_gram_c2_02_010.question: Si el demandado no ___ en el plazo de diez días, se procederá en rebeldía. (comparecer, future subjunctive, él — legal register)
q_gram_c2_02_010.explanation: trong legal documents,  future subjunctive được sử dụng trong conditional clauses about hypothetical future events. 'Si no compareciere' có nghĩa là 'should  defendant not appear'.  future subjunctive của 'comparecer' is formed from  preterite stem comparec- + -iere. Modern legal reform often replaces this with 'si no comparece'.
q_gram_c2_02_010.conjugation_info: comparecer (future subjunctive): compareciere, comparecieres, compareciere, compareciéremos, compareciereis, comparecieren

q_gram_c2_03_001.question: Vos ___ muy amable conmigo. (ser, Argentine voseo, present indicative)
q_gram_c2_03_001.explanation: trong Argentine và Rioplatense voseo,  present indicative của 'ser' with 'vos' is 'sos' (not  Peninsular 'eres' cho tú hoặc 'sois' cho vosotros).  voseo conjugation thường stresses  last syllable và simplifies diphthongs.
q_gram_c2_03_001.hint: Argentine voseo uses unique present tense forms

q_gram_c2_03_002.question: En algunas regiones, se usa 'le' en lugar de 'lo' como pronombre de objeto directo masculino: 'Le vi ayer.' Esto se llama ___.
q_gram_c2_03_002.explanation: Leísmo is  use của  indirect object pronoun 'le' trong place của  direct object pronoun 'lo' (hoặc 'la'). 'Le vi ayer' instead của 'Lo vi ayer' is characteristic của central Spain (Castile).  RAE accepts leísmo cho nam tính số ít animate referents but considers it incorrect cho nữ tính hoặc inanimate referents.

q_gram_c2_03_003.question: What is the key grammatical difference between 'ustedes' usage in Peninsular Spanish and Latin American Spanish?
q_gram_c2_03_003.correct: In Peninsular Spanish, 'ustedes' is exclusively formal plural (vs. informal 'vosotros'); in Latin American Spanish, 'ustedes' serves as both formal and informal plural, replacing 'vosotros' entirely
wrong: In Peninsular Spanish, 'ustedes' takes second-person plural verbs; in Latin American Spanish it takes third-person plural verbs
In Peninsular Spanish, 'ustedes' is only used for women; in Latin American Spanish it is gender-neutral
There is no grammatical difference; the distinction is purely one of pronunciation
q_gram_c2_03_003.explanation: This is one của  most significant dialectal grammar differences trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha. Peninsular Spanish maintains a two-way informal/formal distinction trong  số nhiều: vosotros/as (informal) vs. ustedes (formal). Latin American Spanish has eliminated 'vosotros' entirely, using 'ustedes' with third-person số nhiều verbs cho all số nhiều addresses regardless của formality.

q_gram_c2_03_004.question: Vos ___ a la fiesta anoche, ¿verdad? (ir, Argentine voseo, preterite)
q_gram_c2_03_004.explanation: trong  Argentine voseo,  preterite forms are identical để  standard 'tú' forms. 'Vos fuiste' is correct, not 'fuistes' (a common hypercorrection) hoặc 'fuisteis' ( vosotros form).  voseo diverges from tuteo mainly trong  present indicative, present subjunctive, và imperative, not trong  preterite.
q_gram_c2_03_004.conjugation_info: ir (preterite with voseo): vos fuiste (same as tú fuiste)

q_gram_c2_03_005.question: La di un libro a María. (identify  dialectal phenomenon và  standard correction: ___)
q_gram_c2_03_005.correct: laísmo — the standard form is 'Le di un libro a María'
wrong: leísmo — the standard form is 'Lo di un libro a María'
loísmo — the standard form is 'Le di un libro a María'
dequeísmo — the standard form is 'La di de un libro a María'
q_gram_c2_03_005.explanation: Laísmo is  use của 'la' as an indirect object pronoun cho nữ tính referents instead của  standard 'le'. 'La di un libro' should be 'Le di un libro' vì 'dar algo a alguien' requires an indirect object pronoun ('le'). Laísmo is common trong parts của central Spain (Madrid, Castile) but is considered incorrect by  RAE.
q_gram_c2_03_005.hint: 'Dar' takes an indirect object cho  recipient

q_gram_c2_03_006.question: ¡Sentate acá! (rewrite using voseo imperative của 'sentarse' — identify  correct form)
q_gram_c2_03_006.explanation: trong  Argentine voseo imperative, -ar verbs drop  final -r của  infinitive và stress  last syllable: sentar → sentá. With  reflexive pronoun 'te', it becomes 'sentate' (no written accent vì  stress falls naturally on  penultimate syllable của  combined form). Peninsular 'siéntate' uses  tú imperative with a stem change.
q_gram_c2_03_006.conjugation_info: sentarse (voseo imperative): sentate | Standard tú imperative: siéntate

q_gram_c2_03_007.question: En el Caribe, es común escuchar la aspiración o elisión de la /s/ final. ¿Cómo se pronunciaría 'estos libros' en esta variedad?
q_gram_c2_03_007.explanation: trong Caribbean Spanish (Cuba, Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, coastal Venezuela và Colombia), word-final và syllable-final /s/ is frequently aspirated để [h] hoặc deleted entirely. 'Estos libros' becomes approximately [ehtoh libroh]. This phonological feature is one của  most recognizable markers của Caribbean và lowland Latin American dialects.
q_gram_c2_03_007.hint: /s/ is aspirated (weakened để an 'h' sound), not changed để 'z'

q_gram_c2_03_008.question: I saw him yesterday tại  market. (Translate using  leísmo form accepted by  RAE cho nam tính số ít animate referents)
q_gram_c2_03_008.correct: Le vi ayer en el mercado.
wrong: Lo vi ayer en el mercado.
La vi ayer en el mercado.
Les vi ayer en el mercado.
q_gram_c2_03_008.explanation: RAE accepts leísmo cho nam tính số ít animate referents: 'Le vi' (instead của  etymologically correct 'Lo vi') when referring để a male person. This is  only type của leísmo considered acceptable. Leísmo with nữ tính, số nhiều, hoặc inanimate referents is not accepted.

q_gram_c2_03_009.question: Vos ___ que estudiar más si querés aprobar. (tener, Argentine voseo, present indicative)
q_gram_c2_03_009.explanation: trong Argentine voseo, -er verbs trong  present indicative stress  final syllable và eliminate  diphthong: tener → tenés (not tienes). Chilean voseo sometimes uses 'tenís' (with aspiration), but  Rioplatense form is 'tenés'.  vosotros form 'tenéis' is not used trong Latin America.
q_gram_c2_03_009.conjugation_info: tener (present indicative, voseo): vos tenés | Chilean: vos tenís | Standard tú: tienes

q_gram_c2_03_010.question: ¿Vos querés que yo te lo diga o preferís que me calle?
q_gram_c2_03_010.correct: Do you want me to tell you, or do you prefer that I keep quiet?
wrong: Do you all want me to tell you, or do you prefer that I remain silent?
Would you like me to tell you, or would you prefer that I shut up?
Did you want me to tell you, or did you prefer that I stayed quiet?
q_gram_c2_03_010.explanation: This sentence uses Argentine voseo forms: 'querés' (present indicative của querer with vos) và 'preferís' (present indicative của preferir with vos).  'vos' pronoun addresses a single person informally, equivalent để 'tú', not  số nhiều 'vosotros'.  subjunctive forms 'diga' và 'calle' remain standard regardless của  voseo.

q_gram_c2_04_001.question: ¿No le ___ abrir la ventana? (importar, conditional, usted — polite indirect request)
q_gram_c2_04_001.explanation: conditional 'importaría' softens  request, making it more polite than  present 'importa'. '¿No le importaría abrir la ventana?' (Would you mind opening  window?) is a conventional indirect speech act:  literal question about  hearer's feelings functions pragmatically as a polite request.
q_gram_c2_04_001.conjugation_info: importar (conditional): importaría, importarías, importaría, importaríamos, importaríais, importarían

q_gram_c2_04_002.question: Yo que tú, no ___ eso. (decir, conditional, yo — pragmatic advice softener)
q_gram_c2_04_002.explanation: 'Yo que tú' (if I were you) is an idiomatic pragmatic softener used để give advice indirectly.  main clause takes  conditional ('diría') để express  hypothetical nature của  advice. This structure is more tactful than a direct imperative like 'no digas eso'.
q_gram_c2_04_002.hint: 'Yo que tú' functions like 'si yo fuera tú' but is more colloquial

q_gram_c2_04_003.question: Disculpe, ¿me ___ indicar dónde está la estación? (poder, conditional — formal politeness strategy)
q_gram_c2_04_003.explanation: Using  conditional 'podría' instead của  present 'puede' is a negative politeness strategy mà respects  hearer's autonomy by framing  request as hypothetical rather than presumptive. 'Podría' implies 'if it wouldn't be too much trouble', creating social distance appropriate cho speaking with strangers.
q_gram_c2_04_003.hint: conditional creates social distance và reduces imposition

q_gram_c2_04_004.question: What pragmatic function does the diminutive serve in the Mexican Spanish expression 'ahorita vengo'?
q_gram_c2_04_004.correct: It functions as a pragmatic softener indicating immediacy and reassurance, not literal smallness — it means 'I'll be right back'
wrong: It indicates that the speaker will come back for only a short visit
It is a grammatical error common in uneducated speech, as 'ahora' cannot take diminutives
It means the speaker is going to a small or nearby place
q_gram_c2_04_004.explanation: 'Ahorita' trong Mexican và Central American Spanish is a pragmatic diminutive mà modifies  temporal adverb 'ahora'. Rather than indicating smallness,  diminutive suffix -ita serves as a softening và immediatizing device: 'ahorita' feels warmer và more immediate than 'ahora'. This pragmatic use của diminutives extends để many expressions: 'cerquita' (nice và close), 'lueguito' (right away).

q_gram_c2_04_005.question: Quisiera ___ una mesa para dos, por favor. (reservar — ultra-polite request using imperfect subjunctive của querer)
q_gram_c2_04_005.explanation: 'Quisiera + infinitive' is  most polite request form trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha, using  imperfect subjunctive của 'querer' (-ra form). nó là more polite than 'querría' (conditional) và far more polite than 'quiero' (present).  infinitive 'reservar' follows directly vì  subject của both verbs is  same person.
q_gram_c2_04_005.conjugation_info: querer (imperfect subjunctive): quisiera, quisieras, quisiera, quisiéramos, quisierais, quisieran

q_gram_c2_04_006.question: Es que no ___ la hora de la reunión. (saber, imperfect indicative, yo — excuse-giving pragmatic marker)
q_gram_c2_04_006.explanation: 'Es que' is a pragmatic discourse marker used để introduce excuses, explanations, hoặc justifications. It prefaces  speaker's reason trong a way mà solicits  hearer's understanding. Here, 'es que no sabía' ( thing is, I didn't know) uses  imperfect 'sabía' để describe an ongoing state của ignorance as a mitigating excuse.
q_gram_c2_04_006.hint: 'Es que' introduces an explanation, và  imperfect describes an ongoing past state

q_gram_c2_04_007.question: I was wondering if you could help me with this report. (Translate using maximum politeness)
q_gram_c2_04_007.correct: Me preguntaba si podría ayudarme con este informe.
wrong: Me pregunto si puede ayudarme con este informe.
Me pregunté si pudieras ayudarme con este informe.
Preguntaría si me ayuda con este informe.
q_gram_c2_04_007.explanation: Maximum politeness trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha stacks multiple distancing strategies:  imperfect 'preguntaba' (past tense cho psychological distance) +  conditional 'podría' (hypothetical framing). This double softening mirrors  English 'I was wondering if you could...'. Using present tense 'pregunto' và 'puede' would be significantly more direct.

q_gram_c2_04_008.question: Hombre, ___ que no es tan difícil como parece. (pragmatic filler particle + verb, present indicative, yo)
q_gram_c2_04_008.explanation: vocative 'hombre' (literally 'man') functions as a pragmatic marker của familiarity và mild disagreement, not as a gendered address. 'Yo creo que' with  indicative asserts  speaker's belief while  explicit 'yo' adds mild emphasis. This combination của 'hombre' + 'yo creo que' is a common conversational strategy cho softening a contrary opinion.
q_gram_c2_04_008.hint: 'Hombre' here is a discourse marker, và  verb expresses personal opinion

q_gram_c2_04_009.question: No sé cómo decirle esto, pero me temo que su solicitud no ha sido aceptada.
q_gram_c2_04_009.correct: I don't know how to tell you this, but I'm afraid your application has not been accepted.
wrong: I don't know what to say, but I think your request was not accepted.
I cannot tell you this, but I fear that your application was rejected.
I'm not sure how to say this, but your application might not have been accepted.
q_gram_c2_04_009.explanation: This sentence demonstrates multiple pragmatic softening strategies cho delivering bad news: 'no sé cómo decirle' (prefatory hedging), 'me temo que' (epistemic distancing — literally 'I fear mà'), và  formal 'le' (usted register).  present perfect 'ha sido aceptada' is  appropriate tense cho announcing a result, và  passive voice depersonalizes  rejection.

q_gram_c2_04_010.question: ¿No ___ usted tan amable de pasarme la sal? (ser, future indicative — rhetorical politeness with future tense)
q_gram_c2_04_010.explanation: future tense can be used pragmatically cho polite requests trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha: '¿No será usted tan amable de...?' (Won't you be so kind as để...?). This is  'future của politeness', where  future tense creates psychological distance similar để  conditional. While 'sería' is also very polite,  future tense version has a slightly more formal, old-fashioned elegance.
q_gram_c2_04_010.conjugation_info: ser (future indicative): seré, serás, será, seremos, seréis, serán

q_gram_c2_05_001.question: El presunto autor del robo ___ detenido ayer por la policía. (ser, preterite — journalistic passive voice)
q_gram_c2_05_001.explanation: trong journalistic Spanish,  passive voice with 'ser' trong  preterite ('fue detenido') is standard cho reporting completed events. This contrasts with everyday spoken Spanish, mà strongly prefers active constructions hoặc 'se' passives.  journalistic passive creates objectivity và formality. 'Ha sido' (present perfect) would suggest closer temporal relevance.
q_gram_c2_05_001.hint: Journalistic reporting của a completed past event uses  preterite passive

q_gram_c2_05_002.question: Según fuentes consultadas, el acuerdo ___ firmado en los próximos días. (ser, future — journalistic hedged prediction)
q_gram_c2_05_002.explanation: trong journalistic Spanish, 'será firmado' (future passive) reports a predicted event as fact.  attribution 'según fuentes consultadas' provides  hedge.  conditional 'sería' would indicate more uncertainty. Journalistic register frequently uses future passive constructions mà would sound unnatural trong everyday conversation.
q_gram_c2_05_002.hint: Journalistic predictions about scheduled future events use  future tense

q_gram_c2_05_003.question: What is the primary grammatical characteristic of legal Spanish that distinguishes it from everyday language?
q_gram_c2_05_003.correct: Heavy use of future subjunctive, long nominal phrases, archaic formulas, and passive constructions with 'ser', resulting in highly complex sentence structures
wrong: Exclusive use of the informal 'tú' register to make legal texts accessible to all citizens
Predominance of simple present tense and short sentences for clarity and precision
Use of the imperative mood throughout, since laws are commands to citizens
q_gram_c2_05_003.explanation: Legal Spanish (español jurídico) is characterized by  future subjunctive ('si el acusado negare...'), lengthy subordinate clauses, nominal phrases (nominalization của verbs), archaic formulas ('por la presente', 'en virtud de'), và passive voice with 'ser'. These features create density và formality mà can make legal texts nearly impenetrable để non-specialists.

q_gram_c2_05_004.question: Se ___ que los resultados confirman la hipótesis inicial. (observar, preterite, impersonal 'se' — scientific register)
q_gram_c2_05_004.explanation: trong scientific Spanish,  impersonal 'se' + preterite ('se observó') is  standard way để report findings objectively, avoiding personal subjects like 'yo observé' hoặc 'nosotros observamos'.  preterite indicates a completed observation within  study. This impersonal construction is a defining feature của academic và scientific writing trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha.
q_gram_c2_05_004.conjugation_info: observar (preterite): observé, observaste, observó, observamos, observasteis, observaron

q_gram_c2_05_005.question: Los datos ___ analizados mediante un método estadístico de regresión lineal. (ser, preterite, passive — scientific paper methodology section)
q_gram_c2_05_005.explanation: trong  methodology section của scientific papers,  passive preterite ('fueron analizados') reports completed procedures. This passive construction maintains  impersonal tone expected trong academic writing. 'Han sido' (present perfect) would be used cho results with ongoing relevance, while  preterite indicates a discrete completed action within  study.

q_gram_c2_05_006.question: Descubre ___ tu nueva piel con nuestra crema revolucionaria. (a verb form typical của advertising — tú imperative của 'ser')
q_gram_c2_05_006.explanation: Advertising Spanish heavily favors  informal imperative để create urgency và personal connection: 'Descubre' (discover), 'sé' (be).  tú imperative của 'ser' is  irregular form 'sé' (identical để  yo form của 'saber'). Advertising discourse strings imperatives together để build excitement. Using 'usted' forms would create unwanted distance trong most modern ad copy.

q_gram_c2_05_007.question: La tasa de desempleo ___ incrementado en un 2% durante el último trimestre, según el INE. (haberse, present perfect, impersonal reflexive — economic journalism)
q_gram_c2_05_007.explanation: Economic journalism trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha uses  reflexive impersonal construction 'se ha incrementado' để present data objectively.  present perfect ('se ha incrementado') được sử dụng vì  time frame ('durante el último trimestre') connects để  present. This reflexive-passive is preferred over  agentive passive ('ha sido incrementada') vì no specific agent caused  increase.
q_gram_c2_05_007.hint: increase happened within a recent time frame connected để  present

q_gram_c2_05_008.question: It was concluded mà  treatment significantly reduces symptoms trong 78% của patients. (Translate using scientific register)
q_gram_c2_05_008.correct: Se concluyó que el tratamiento reduce significativamente los síntomas en el 78% de los pacientes.
wrong: Concluimos que el tratamiento reduce significativamente los síntomas en el 78% de los pacientes.
Fue concluido que el tratamiento reduce los síntomas significativamente en 78% de los pacientes.
Se ha concluido que el tratamiento redujo los síntomas en el 78% de los pacientes.
q_gram_c2_05_008.explanation: Scientific Spanish uses  impersonal 'se concluyó' rather than  personal 'concluimos' hoặc  passive 'fue concluido' (là grammatically awkward with 'concluir' trong this context). mạo từ 'el' before '78%' is standard trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha scientific writing. 'Significativamente' is placed before  verb it modifies cho formal precision.

q_gram_c2_05_009.question: Por la presente, se ___ a las partes que el plazo vence el día 15 del corriente mes. (notificar, present indicative, impersonal 'se' — legal/administrative register)
q_gram_c2_05_009.explanation: trong legal và administrative documents, 'por la presente' (hereby) introduces a formal notification using  impersonal 'se' + present indicative. 'Se notifica' (hereby nó là notified) performs  legal speech act tại  moment của writing.  performative present tense makes  notification effective upon issuance.  formula 'del corriente mes' (của  current month) is a fixed legal expression.
q_gram_c2_05_009.conjugation_info: notificar (present indicative): notifico, notificas, notifica, notificamos, notificáis, notifican

q_gram_c2_05_010.question: Habida cuenta de las circunstancias expuestas, este tribunal resuelve desestimar la demanda interpuesta.
q_gram_c2_05_010.correct: In consideration of the circumstances set forth, this court resolves to dismiss the complaint filed.
wrong: Having considered the exposed circumstances, this tribunal resolves to disregard the demand.
Given that the circumstances have been expressed, this court decides to reject the interpellated demand.
On account of the stated circumstances, this court orders the removal of the intermediary claim.
q_gram_c2_05_010.explanation: 'Habida cuenta de' (trong consideration của) is a fixed legal formula. 'Circunstancias expuestas' có nghĩa là 'circumstances set forth' (not 'exposed'). 'Resuelve desestimar' is  legal performative cho 'resolves để dismiss'. 'Demanda interpuesta' có nghĩa là 'complaint filed' (not 'intermediary' hoặc 'interpellated'). Legal Spanish relies heavily on such fixed collocations mà have specific technical meanings distinct from everyday usage.

q_gram_c2_06_001.question: El informe concluye lo siguiente___ los resultados son definitivos. (Choose  correct punctuation + conjunction pattern)
q_gram_c2_06_001.explanation: After 'lo siguiente' ( following), a colon (:) is required trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha để introduce what follows. A semicolon would separate independent clauses without  introductory relationship, và a dash được sử dụng cho parenthetical insertions, not introductions.
q_gram_c2_06_001.conjugation_info: Colon usage: after 'lo siguiente', 'a saber', 'es decir' when introducing explanatory content

q_gram_c2_06_002.question: La propuesta fue rechazada___ sin embargo, el comité acordó reconsiderarla.
q_gram_c2_06_002.explanation: A semicolon is required before adversative conjuncts like 'sin embargo', 'no obstante', và 'ahora bien' when they connect two independent clauses. A comma alone creates a comma splice (coma criminal) trong formal Spanish prose.
q_gram_c2_06_002.hint: Adversative connectors between independent clauses require stronger punctuation than a comma

q_gram_c2_06_003.question: Tres ciudades participaron en el proyecto___ Madrid, Barcelona y Sevilla.
q_gram_c2_06_003.explanation: A colon được sử dụng before an enumeration mà has been announced by a cataphoric element (trong this case, 'tres ciudades').  colon signals mà what follows specifies hoặc lists what was previously announced. A dash would only be appropriate cho a parenthetical aside.
q_gram_c2_06_003.hint: sentence announces a list with 'tres ciudades' — what punctuation introduces  enumeration?

q_gram_c2_06_004.question: What is the grammatical difference between 'Mi hermano, que vive en Madrid, es médico' and 'Mi hermano que vive en Madrid es médico'?
q_gram_c2_06_004.correct: The first (with commas) is a non-restrictive clause implying one brother; the second (without commas) is restrictive, implying there are multiple brothers and identifying which one
wrong: There is no grammatical difference; the commas are optional stylistic choices
The first is informal and the second is formal register
The first uses the indicative mood and the second implies subjunctive
q_gram_c2_06_004.explanation: trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha, commas around a relative clause determine whether nó là explicativa (non-restrictive, providing extra information) hoặc especificativa (restrictive, narrowing down mà referent). This punctuation distinction changes có nghĩa là: with commas,  speaker has one brother; without,  speaker has multiple brothers và is specifying mà one.

q_gram_c2_06_005.question: El director declaró___ «No habrá más despidos este trimestre». ( director stated___)
q_gram_c2_06_005.explanation: trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha, a colon precedes a direct quotation introduced by a verb của communication (declarar, decir, afirmar). Unlike English, mà may use a comma, Spanish formal style requires a colon before quoted speech when introduced by a declarative verb.
q_gram_c2_06_005.conjugation_info: Verbs của communication (declarar, afirmar, señalar) + colon + quoted speech is standard trong formal/journalistic Spanish

q_gram_c2_06_006.question: Todo estaba en calma___ de repente, un ruido ensordecedor sacudió el edificio.
q_gram_c2_06_006.explanation: A semicolon separates two closely related independent clauses where  second introduces a contrasting hoặc unexpected turn. 'De repente' (suddenly) introduces a shift;  semicolon is stronger than a comma (mà would create a comma splice) but maintains  close narrative relationship mà a full stop would sever.
q_gram_c2_06_006.hint: Two independent clauses with a close temporal relationship và dramatic contrast

q_gram_c2_06_007.question: The results were as follows: three in favor, two against, and one abstention.
q_gram_c2_06_007.correct: Los resultados fueron los siguientes: tres a favor, dos en contra y una abstención.
wrong: Los resultados fueron los siguientes; tres a favor, dos en contra y una abstención.
Los resultados fueron los siguientes — tres a favor, dos en contra y una abstención.
Los resultados fueron los siguientes, tres a favor, dos en contra y una abstención.
q_gram_c2_06_007.explanation: After 'los siguientes' ( following), Spanish requires a colon để introduce  enumeration. Note mà trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha,  serial comma (Oxford comma) before 'y' is not used — unlike English, Spanish omits  comma before  final conjunction trong a simple list.

q_gram_c2_06_008.question: Solo quería una cosa___ que lo dejaran en paz.
q_gram_c2_06_008.explanation: A colon follows a cataphoric expression ('una cosa') mà announces what will be specified.  colon introduces  specification của 'una cosa'. This is distinct from  dash (raya), mà would be used cho a parenthetical aside hoặc interruption, not a direct specification.
q_gram_c2_06_008.hint: 'Una cosa' announces a specification — what punctuation mark introduces it?

q_gram_c2_06_009.question: La cuestión es sencilla: o aceptamos las condiciones —por injustas que sean— o nos retiramos del acuerdo.
q_gram_c2_06_009.correct: The issue is simple: either we accept the conditions — however unjust they may be — or we withdraw from the agreement.
wrong: The simple question is: we accept the conditions, however unjust they are, or we withdraw from the agreement.
The issue is simple; either we accept the conditions (however unjust they are) or we withdraw from the agreement.
The question is easy: or we accept the conditions — for unjust as they are — or we retire from the agreement.
q_gram_c2_06_009.explanation: colon after 'sencilla' introduces an explanation.  em dashes (rayas) enclose a concessive parenthetical clause ('por injustas que sean' = however unjust they may be). 'Retirarse del acuerdo' có nghĩa là 'để withdraw from  agreement', not 'để retire'.  correlative 'o...o' translates để 'either...hoặc'.

q_gram_c2_06_010.question: Había dos opciones —según nos explicaron—___ aceptar o renunciar. (haber, imperfect indicative — already conjugated; choose  correct punctuation after  parenthetical)
q_gram_c2_06_010.explanation: em dashes (rayas) enclose  parenthetical 'según nos explicaron' (as they explained để us). After  closing dash, a colon introduces  specification của 'dos opciones'.  colon functions as a cataphoric marker, và  parenthetical insertion between dashes does not change  punctuation logic của  main sentence.
q_gram_c2_06_010.conjugation_info: Parenthetical insertions between rayas do not alter  punctuation requirements của  main clause structure

q_gram_c2_07_001.question: Sírvase ___ a la recepción a las nueve en punto. (acudir, ultra-formal imperative usted)
q_gram_c2_07_001.explanation: 'Sírvase' + infinitive is an ultra-formal imperative construction used trong official correspondence, legal documents, và bureaucratic language. 'Sírvase acudir' is more formal than 'acuda' (standard formal imperative). This register is characteristic của administrative Spanish.
q_gram_c2_07_001.hint: 'Sírvase' được theo sau bởi an infinitive trong ultra-formal register

q_gram_c2_07_002.question: Tío, es que ___ flipando con lo que me ha dicho el profe. (estar, colloquial present progressive, yo form)
q_gram_c2_07_002.explanation: trong colloquial Spanish (registro coloquial), 'tío' (dude), 'es que' (it's just mà), 'flipar' (để freak out), và 'profe' (teacher, truncated) are markers của informal youth register.  present progressive 'estoy flipando' conveys an immediate emotional reaction typical của spoken informal Spanish.

q_gram_c2_07_003.question: What register shift occurs when a speaker says 'Ruego a usted tenga a bien considerar mi solicitud' versus 'Por favor, considere mi solicitud'?
q_gram_c2_07_003.correct: Both are formal, but the first uses ultra-formal bureaucratic register with archaic constructions ('tenga a bien'), while the second is standard polite formal register
wrong: The first is informal because it uses 'ruego' which is a casual word
Both sentences are in exactly the same register with no meaningful difference
The first is written register and the second can only be used in spoken language
q_gram_c2_07_003.explanation: 'Tener a bien' (để see fit để) is an ultra-formal/archaic construction found trong legal và administrative documents. 'Ruego a usted tenga a bien' belongs để  highest formality tier (registro solemne/protocolario), while 'por favor, considere' is standard formal (registro formal estándar). Mastering register có nghĩa là recognizing these gradations.

q_gram_c2_07_004.question: Se ___ a los señores pasajeros que abrochen sus cinturones. (rogar, formal announcement, third person số ít passive)
q_gram_c2_07_004.explanation: 'Se ruega a los señores pasajeros' (passengers are kindly requested) is a formulaic expression trong formal public announcements.  impersonal 'se' + third person số ít của 'rogar' creates a depersonalized, institutional voice. 'Se pide' would be less formal; 'se solicita' được sử dụng cho applications; 'se implora' is too emotionally charged.
q_gram_c2_07_004.conjugation_info: rogar (present indicative): ruego, ruegas, ruega, rogamos, rogáis, ruegan — note  o→ue stem change

q_gram_c2_07_005.question: Habida cuenta de las circunstancias, ___ oportuno aplazar la sesión. (resultar, ultra-formal written register)
q_gram_c2_07_005.explanation: 'Habida cuenta de' (trong view của / given) is an ultra-formal connector used trong legal, academic, và parliamentary discourse. 'Resulta oportuno' (it proves/turns out để be appropriate) is  register-appropriate verb choice. 'Es oportuno' would be standard formal; 'resultar' adds  nuance của objective conclusion characteristic của this register.
q_gram_c2_07_005.hint: 'Habida cuenta de' signals ultra-formal register — mà verb matches this tone?

q_gram_c2_07_006.question: Quienquiera que ___ responsable deberá rendir cuentas ante el tribunal. (ser, present subjunctive, formal legal register)
q_gram_c2_07_006.explanation: 'Quienquiera que' (whoever) is a formal/literary pronoun mà always triggers  subjunctive. trong legal register referring để a present/future unknown person,  present subjunctive 'sea' is required.  imperfect subjunctive 'fuera/fuese' would be used cho past hoặc hypothetical contexts.
q_gram_c2_07_006.conjugation_info: ser (present subjunctive): sea, seas, sea, seamos, seáis, sean

q_gram_c2_07_007.question: Venga, ¡___ aquí! ¡Que no pasa nada, hombre! (venir, informal tú imperative, colloquial register)
q_gram_c2_07_007.explanation: trong colloquial register, discourse markers like 'venga' (come on), 'hombre' (man/dude, regardless của giống), và 'que no pasa nada' (it's no big deal) signal intimacy và informality.  tú imperative 'ven' matches this register. 'Venga' (usted imperative) would clash with  colloquial tone.
q_gram_c2_07_007.hint: colloquial markers (venga, hombre) signal tú register

q_gram_c2_07_008.question: I hereby request mà my application be reconsidered. (ultra-formal register)
q_gram_c2_07_008.correct: Por la presente, solicito que mi solicitud sea reconsiderada.
wrong: Quiero que se reconsidere mi solicitud, por favor.
Le ruego me reconsidere la solicitud.
q_gram_c2_07_008.explanation: 'Por la presente' (hereby) is a formulaic expression exclusive để ultra-formal written register (legal, administrative). 'Solicito que... sea reconsiderada' uses  formal verb 'solicitar' with passive subjunctive, matching  institutional tone.  alternatives are progressively less formal và would not appear trong official documents.

q_gram_c2_07_009.question: Dígnese Su Señoría ___ las pruebas que a continuación se exponen. (examinar, ultra-formal judicial imperative)
q_gram_c2_07_009.explanation: 'Dígnese' (may [Your Honor] deign để) + infinitive is  most formal imperative construction trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha, reserved cho addressing judges (Su Señoría), royalty, hoặc high dignitaries. This archaic construction follows  pattern: reflexive courtesy verb + infinitive. It represents  highest register tier trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha.
q_gram_c2_07_009.conjugation_info: dignarse (formal imperative): dígnese + infinitive — ultra-formal/judicial register only

q_gram_c2_07_010.question: Mola mogollón, ¿eh? Es que el tío ese es un crack total, ¿sabes?
q_gram_c2_07_010.correct: It's really cool, right? The thing is, that guy is an absolute legend, you know?
wrong: It bothers a lot, right? That uncle is a total crack, do you know?
It's a little cool, isn't it? That man is a complete failure, you know?
It is moderately annoying, correct? The gentleman is a total expert, do you understand?
q_gram_c2_07_010.explanation: 'Molar' (để be cool, colloquial), 'mogollón' (a ton/really, colloquial intensifier), 'tío' (guy/dude, not 'uncle' here), 'un crack' (a legend/genius, from English), và '¿sabes?' (you know?, phatic) are all markers của highly colloquial youth register. Translating register accurately có nghĩa là choosing equivalent colloquial expressions trong  target language.

q_gram_c2_08_001.question: Caminaba por la calle cuando, de pronto, ___ ante él una figura sombría. (aparecer, literary pretérito indefinido cho narrative rupture)
q_gram_c2_08_001.explanation: trong literary narrative,  imperfect ('caminaba') sets  background scene, và  pretérito indefinido ('apareció') interrupts with a foreground event. This alternation between imperfect (description/background) và indefinido (action/foreground) is fundamental để Spanish narrative technique. 'De pronto' (suddenly) signals  narrative rupture.
q_gram_c2_08_001.conjugation_info: aparecer (pretérito indefinido): aparecí, apareciste, apareció, aparecimos, aparecisteis, aparecieron

q_gram_c2_08_002.question: No podía creerlo. ___ irse de allí cuanto antes. Nadie debía enterarse. (tener que, free indirect style, imperfect)
q_gram_c2_08_002.explanation: Free indirect style (estilo indirecto libre) blends  narrator's voice with  character's thoughts without quotation marks hoặc reporting verbs.  imperfect 'tenía que' reflects  character's internal urgency as filtered through  narrator.  short, decisive sentences ('No podía creerlo. Tenía que irse.') are characteristic của this literary technique.
q_gram_c2_08_002.hint: Free indirect style uses  character's tense perspective — here,  imperfect mirrors internal thought

q_gram_c2_08_003.question: Y el soldado, que nunca ___ miedo a nada, tembló por primera vez. (haber tenido, pluperfect indicative cho literary characterization)
q_gram_c2_08_003.explanation: pluperfect 'había tenido' establishes a character trait mà held true up until  narrative moment của rupture ('tembló por primera vez'). trong literary analysis,  pluperfect creates a temporal depth mà  imperfect hoặc indefinido alone cannot achieve — it frames  character's entire past as context cho  present dramatic event.
q_gram_c2_08_003.hint: pluperfect establishes a completed state prior để  narrative turning point

q_gram_c2_08_004.question: trong literary analysis, what is  grammatical function của  'presente histórico' (historical present) trong narrative prose?
q_gram_c2_08_004.correct: It uses present tense to narrate past events, creating immediacy and dramatic vividness by collapsing the temporal distance between narrator and events
wrong: It is used only in dialogue to indicate characters speaking in real time
It is a subjunctive form used to express the author's doubts about historical accuracy
It is a future tense form used to foreshadow upcoming events in the plot
q_gram_c2_08_004.explanation: presente histórico is a powerful literary device where past events are narrated trong  present tense ('Colón llega a América en 1492'). Grammatically, it transposes  temporal frame, creating an effect của immediacy và reader immersion. trong literary analysis, recognizing this device is essential cho understanding narrative perspective và  author's stylistic choices.

q_gram_c2_08_005.question: Mañana ___ el día decisivo. Lo sabía. Lo sentía en los huesos. (ser, literary present cho narrative anticipation mixed with imperfect cho interiority)
q_gram_c2_08_005.explanation: conditional 'sería' trong literary narrative functions as a 'future của  past' — it expresses  character's anticipation của a future event from a past narrative standpoint. Combined with  imperfect ('sabía', 'sentía'), it creates a layered temporal perspective characteristic của sophisticated literary prose. This is distinct from  simple imperfect 'era', mà would merely describe.
q_gram_c2_08_005.conjugation_info: ser (conditional): sería, serías, sería, seríamos, seríais, serían

q_gram_c2_08_006.question: Le miraron con desprecio. ___ un intruso, un don nadie. ¿Qué hacía allí? (ser, free indirect style, imperfect)
q_gram_c2_08_006.explanation: trong free indirect style,  imperfect 'era' expresses  collective judgment của  characters ('le miraron') as internalized thought.  rhetorical question '¿Qué hacía allí?' further signals free indirect style — nó là neither  narrator's nor a character's direct speech, but a fusion của both perspectives.  imperfect maintains  narrative past frame.
q_gram_c2_08_006.hint: Free indirect style merges narrator và character perspective using past tenses

q_gram_c2_08_007.question: She had never imagined mà love could hurt so much. (literary translation, pluperfect + free indirect style)
q_gram_c2_08_007.correct: Nunca había imaginado que el amor pudiera doler tanto.
wrong: Nunca imaginó que el amor podía doler tanto.
Ella no ha imaginado que el amor pueda doler tanto.
Nunca se imaginaba que el amor dolería tanto.
q_gram_c2_08_007.explanation: pluperfect 'había imaginado' + imperfect subjunctive 'pudiera' creates literary depth:  pluperfect establishes  character's prior state của ignorance, và  subjunctive 'pudiera' (rather than indicative 'podía') adds a layer của unreality để  subordinate clause, characteristic của literary prose mà conveys subjective experience.

q_gram_c2_08_008.question: Llovía. Las calles ___ desiertas. Un perro aullaba a lo lejos. (estar, imperfect cho literary scene-setting)
q_gram_c2_08_008.explanation: accumulation của imperfect verbs ('llovía', 'estaban', 'aullaba') creates a literary backdrop — a static, atmospheric scene before  narrative action begins. This technique, called 'descriptive imperfect' hoặc 'imperfecto descriptivo', is fundamental trong literary analysis. Each imperfect verb adds a layer để  setting without advancing  plot.
q_gram_c2_08_008.hint: Scene-setting trong literary narrative uses accumulated imperfect verbs

q_gram_c2_08_009.question: Hubiera querido gritar, pero las palabras se le atragantaron en la garganta.
q_gram_c2_08_009.correct: She would have wanted to scream, but the words got stuck in her throat.
wrong: She wanted to scream, but the words were stuck in her throat.
She had wanted to scream, but the words would get stuck in her throat.
If she had wanted to scream, the words stuck in her throat.
q_gram_c2_08_009.explanation: trong literary Spanish, 'hubiera querido' (pluperfect subjunctive) can replace 'habría querido' (conditional perfect) để express an unrealized desire. This is a literary register choice —  subjunctive form adds emotional weight và a sense của impossibility. 'Se le atragantaron' (indefinido) conveys  sudden, completed physical sensation.

q_gram_c2_08_010.question: Y entonces lo ___: aquella no era su vida, sino la de otro, la de un desconocido que habitaba su cuerpo. (comprender, literary pretérito indefinido cho epiphany)
q_gram_c2_08_010.explanation: pretérito indefinido 'comprendió' marks  moment của epiphany (anagnórisis) trong literary narrative — a sudden, completed act của understanding mà changes everything.  imperfect 'comprendía' would suggest gradual, ongoing understanding without  dramatic rupture. Literary analysis distinguishes between these aspectual choices as deliberate narrative strategies.
q_gram_c2_08_010.conjugation_info: comprender (pretérito indefinido): comprendí, comprendiste, comprendió, comprendimos, comprendisteis, comprendieron

q_gram_c2_09_001.question: Estoy seguro ___ que vendrá mañana. (Choose  correct preposition, hoặc lack thereof)
q_gram_c2_09_001.explanation: 'Estar seguro de que' is  correct construction (dequeísmo check: 'Estoy seguro DE algo' → 'de que' is required). Omitting 'de' (*'Estoy seguro que') is a common error called queísmo —  incorrect suppression của  preposition 'de' before 'que'. This is one của  most frequent errors even among educated native speakers.
q_gram_c2_09_001.hint: Test: 'Estoy seguro DE algo' →  'de' must be retained before 'que'

q_gram_c2_09_002.question: Me alegro ___ que hayas aprobado el examen. (Choose  correct preposition)
q_gram_c2_09_002.explanation: 'Alegrarse de que' is correct (test: 'me alegro DE algo'). Saying *'me alegro que' is queísmo — an error. Conversely, saying *'me alegro de de que' would be a hypercorrection.  preposition 'de' is inherent để  verb 'alegrarse de' và must be maintained before  conjunction 'que'.
q_gram_c2_09_002.hint: Verb regime test: 'alegrarse DE algo' → 'de que' is mandatory

q_gram_c2_09_003.question: What error does the sentence 'Pienso de que deberías estudiar más' contain?
q_gram_c2_09_003.correct: Dequeísmo: the incorrect insertion of 'de' before 'que' — it should be 'Pienso que deberías estudiar más'
wrong: Leísmo: incorrect use of an indirect object pronoun
Loísmo: incorrect use of a direct object pronoun
q_gram_c2_09_003.explanation: Dequeísmo is  insertion của 'de' before 'que' where it does not belong. Test: 'Pienso ALGO' (not *'pienso DE algo'), therefore 'pienso que' is correct và 'pienso de que' is dequeísmo. This error is stigmatized trong formal Spanish và is a hallmark diagnostic tại C2 level.

q_gram_c2_09_004.question: Los estudiantes, ___ por la noticia, salieron del aula en silencio. (conmover, past participle agreeing with subject — correct concordance)
q_gram_c2_09_004.explanation: past participle trong an absolute participial clause must agree trong giống và number with  noun it modifies. 'Los estudiantes' is nam tính số nhiều, so 'conmovidos' is required. Using 'conmovido' (nam tính số ít) would be a concordance error (error de concordancia). Note: 'conmoviendo' (gerund) would create a different construction entirely.
q_gram_c2_09_004.conjugation_info: conmover (past participle): conmovido/a/os/as — agrees with  noun trong absolute constructions

q_gram_c2_09_005.question: Han habido muchos problemas este año. → Identify and correct the error.
q_gram_c2_09_005.explanation: 'Haber' as an impersonal verb (có nghĩa là 'there is/are') is ALWAYS third person số ít, regardless của what follows. *'Han habido muchos problemas' is incorrect vì 'problemas' is not  subject —  verb is impersonal. This is one của  most common errors among native speakers, especially trong regions like Valencia và Latin America.
q_gram_c2_09_005.hint: Impersonal 'haber' is always số ít: ha habido, había, hubo, habrá

q_gram_c2_09_006.question: La carta ___ enviada ayer por el secretario. (ser, preterite passive — correct passive voice construction)
q_gram_c2_09_006.explanation: passive voice with 'ser' uses  pretérito indefinido 'fue' cho a completed past action with a specified time ('ayer'). Using 'estuvo' (*'estuvo enviada') is a common error — 'estar' + participle describes a resulting state, not  action itself. 'La carta fue enviada' (action) vs. 'La carta estaba enviada' (resulting state) is a crucial distinction.
q_gram_c2_09_006.conjugation_info: ser (pretérito indefinido): fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fuisteis, fueron

q_gram_c2_09_007.question: Llegó corriendo y ___ la puerta de un portazo. (identify correct construction: avoid improper gerund)
q_gram_c2_09_007.explanation: Using a gerund để express a result hoặc subsequent action (*'Llegó cerrando la puerta') is incorrect trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha —  gerund cannot express posteriority.  correct construction uses a conjugated verb ('cerró') coordinated with 'y'. This misuse của  gerund (gerundio de posterioridad) is considered one của  most serious grammatical errors trong formal Spanish.
q_gram_c2_09_007.hint: Spanish gerund cannot express an action mà occurs after  main verb

q_gram_c2_09_008.question: I am convinced mà  project will succeed. (translate correctly, avoiding queísmo)
q_gram_c2_09_008.correct: Estoy convencido de que el proyecto tendrá éxito.
wrong: Estoy convencido que el proyecto tendrá éxito.
Estoy convencido en que el proyecto tendrá éxito.
Soy convencido de que el proyecto tendrá éxito.
q_gram_c2_09_008.explanation: 'Estar convencido DE que' requires  preposition 'de' (test: 'convencido DE algo'). Omitting it (*'convencido que') is queísmo. Additionally, note 'estar convencido' (not *'ser convencido') — conviction is a state (estar), not an inherent characteristic (ser). Both errors are diagnostic tại C2 level.

q_gram_c2_09_009.question: La vieron y, ___ con ella, le entregaron el documento. (hablar, corrected gerund — simultaneous action)
q_gram_c2_09_009.explanation: gerund IS correct when expressing an action simultaneous with hoặc immediately preceding  main verb. 'Hablando con ella, le entregaron el documento' (while speaking with her, they handed her  document) uses  gerund cho simultaneity, là grammatically valid. This contrasts with  prohibited gerund của posteriority.
q_gram_c2_09_009.conjugation_info: Valid gerund uses: simultaneity (cantando, bailaba), manner (llegó corriendo), condition (estudiando más, aprobarás)

q_gram_c2_09_010.question: Habían muchas personas en la sala esperando su turno.
q_gram_c2_09_010.correct: There were many people in the room waiting for their turn. (Note: 'Habían' is grammatically incorrect in standard Spanish — it should be 'Había')
wrong: There had been many people in the room waiting for their turn.
Many people had the room waiting for their turn.
They had many people in the room who were waiting.
q_gram_c2_09_010.explanation: impersonal verb 'haber' (existential: there is/are) must always be conjugated trong  third person số ít: 'había' (not *'habían').  số nhiều noun 'muchas personas' is  direct object, NOT  subject. This error is extremely widespread trong spoken Spanish (especially trong Latin America) but is unacceptable trong formal/written C2-level Spanish.

q_gram_c2_10_001.question: María estudió toda la noche. ___ embargo, no aprobó el examen. (Choose  correct discourse marker cho concession/contrast)
q_gram_c2_10_001.explanation: 'Sin embargo' (however/nevertheless) is a concessive discourse marker mà introduces a result contrary để what  previous clause would lead one để expect. It functions as an adversative connector maintaining cohesion between  two propositions. trong discourse analysis, it signals a counter-argumentative relationship.
q_gram_c2_10_001.conjugation_info: Adversative/concessive markers: sin embargo, no obstante, con todo, ahora bien, aun así

q_gram_c2_10_002.question: La empresa anunció nuevas medidas. ___ incluyen la reducción de la jornada laboral. (Choose  anaphoric pronoun mà maintains cohesion)
q_gram_c2_10_002.explanation: 'Estas' (these) is  correct anaphoric demonstrative vì it refers back để 'nuevas medidas' just mentioned —  most recently introduced referent. trong discourse analysis, 'estas' creates near-distance anaphora (referencing what was just said), while 'aquellas' would suggest greater textual distance. This choice affects discourse cohesion.
q_gram_c2_10_002.hint: Near anaphora (just mentioned) = estas; distant anaphora = aquellas

q_gram_c2_10_003.question: El gobierno implementará un nuevo plan fiscal. ___: primero se revisarán los impuestos, luego se ajustarán las subvenciones. (Choose  appropriate connector cho introducing a detailed specification)
q_gram_c2_10_003.explanation: 'A saber' (namely / để wit) is a discourse marker mà introduces a detailed enumeration hoặc specification của what was previously mentioned. While 'es decir', 'o sea', và 'esto es' are reformulative markers (they rephrase  same idea), 'a saber' specifically introduces a breakdown into parts — it has a particularizing function rather than a reformulative one.
q_gram_c2_10_003.hint: mà marker introduces an enumeration/specification rather than a paraphrase?

q_gram_c2_10_004.question: In discourse analysis, what is the difference between anaphora and cataphora?
q_gram_c2_10_004.correct: Anaphora refers back to something previously mentioned in the text, while cataphora refers forward to something that will be mentioned later
wrong: Anaphora is a literary device of repetition, while cataphora is a grammatical error
Both refer to the same thing: backward reference in text
Anaphora is used in spoken language and cataphora only in written language
q_gram_c2_10_004.explanation: Anaphora (backward reference): 'Juan llegó. ÉL estaba cansado.' (él → Juan). Cataphora (forward reference): 'Lo que te voy a decir es ESTO: no vuelvas.' (esto → no vuelvas). Both are referential mechanisms mà create textual cohesion. Mastering these concepts is essential cho C2-level discourse analysis và academic writing trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha.

q_gram_c2_10_005.question: El proyecto fracasó. No obstante, los investigadores ___ valiosas lecciones de la experiencia. (extraer, pretérito indefinido — maintaining thematic progression)
q_gram_c2_10_005.explanation: 'No obstante' (nevertheless) introduces a counter-argumentative clause.  pretérito indefinido 'extrajeron' maintains  narrative past frame established by 'fracasó'. trong discourse analysis, thematic progression requires tense consistency: both clauses share  same temporal plane (completed past actions), creating a coherent counter-argument.
q_gram_c2_10_005.conjugation_info: extraer (pretérito indefinido): extraje, extrajiste, extrajo, extrajimos, extrajisteis, extrajeron — irregular stem extraj-

q_gram_c2_10_006.question: Algunos expertos defienden la medida. ___, otros la consideran contraproducente. (Choose  discourse marker cho introducing an opposing viewpoint)
q_gram_c2_10_006.explanation: 'En cambio' (on  other hand / trong contrast) is a contrastive discourse marker mà introduces an opposing perspective. 'Además' (moreover) is additive; 'por lo tanto' (therefore) is consecutive; 'asimismo' (likewise) is additive. trong discourse analysis, choosing  correct marker determines  argumentative relationship between propositions.
q_gram_c2_10_006.hint: second clause presents an opposing view — mà marker signals contrast?

q_gram_c2_10_007.question: What I want để emphasize is  following: information structure determines how  message is received. (translate preserving cataphoric structure)
q_gram_c2_10_007.correct: Lo que quiero recalcar es lo siguiente: la estructura informativa determina cómo se recibe el mensaje.
wrong: Quiero recalcar que la estructura informativa determina cómo se recibe el mensaje.
Lo siguiente es lo que quiero recalcar: la estructura informativa determina cómo el mensaje se recibe.
Lo que quiero recalcar es esto, la estructura informativa determina cómo se recibe el mensaje.
q_gram_c2_10_007.explanation: cataphoric construction 'lo que quiero recalcar es lo siguiente:' (what I want để emphasize is  following:) creates anticipation và foregrounds  information mà follows  colon. trong discourse analysis, this is a focusing device (mecanismo de focalización).  alternative without cataphora ('quiero recalcar que...') is grammatically correct but loses  emphatic information structure.

q_gram_c2_10_008.question: La economía creció un 3%. ___ se redujo la tasa de desempleo. (Choose  consecutive discourse marker)
q_gram_c2_10_008.explanation: 'En consecuencia' (consequently/as a result) is a consecutive discourse marker mà establishes a cause-effect relationship: economic growth → reduced unemployment.  other options are adversative/contrastive, mà would contradict  logical relationship between  two propositions. Discourse coherence requires mà connectors match  logical relationship between clauses.
q_gram_c2_10_008.hint: second clause is a result của  first — mà marker signals consequence?

q_gram_c2_10_009.question: En primer lugar, se analizarán los datos. A continuación, se presentarán los resultados. Por último, se extraerán las conclusiones.
q_gram_c2_10_009.correct: First, the data will be analyzed. Next, the results will be presented. Finally, the conclusions will be drawn.
wrong: In the first place, the data is analyzed. Following that, results are presented. At last, conclusions are extracted.
Firstly, they will analyze data. Then, they present results. Lastly, they extract conclusions.
First of all, the data was analyzed. Afterwards, the results were presented. In the end, the conclusions were drawn.
q_gram_c2_10_009.explanation: Spanish text uses ordering discourse markers ('en primer lugar', 'a continuación', 'por último') with passive 'se' constructions trong  future tense, creating an impersonal academic register.  correct translation maintains: (1) sequential markers, (2) passive voice, và (3) future tense consistency. Mixing tenses hoặc voices, as  wrong answers do, breaks discourse coherence.

q_gram_c2_10_010.question: Dicho ___, pasemos al siguiente punto del orden del día. (Choose  anaphoric participle mà summarizes everything previously stated)
q_gram_c2_10_010.explanation: expression 'dicho esto' (having said this / mà said) is an anaphoric discourse marker mà encapsulates everything previously stated và signals a transition để a new topic. 'Esto' refers để  immediately preceding discourse (near reference). 'Dicho eso' would suggest more distance; 'dicho aquello' implies remote reference. trong discourse analysis, 'dicho esto' functions as both a summarizing anaphor và a transitional marker.
q_gram_c2_10_010.conjugation_info: Summarizing anaphoric expressions: dicho esto, en vista de lo anterior, teniendo en cuenta lo expuesto, a la luz de lo dicho

q_gram_c2_11_001.question: In Spanish, the English phrase 'I am hungry' becomes 'Tengo ___'. What translation technique is applied here?
q_gram_c2_11_001.explanation: Spanish uses 'tener hambre' (để have hunger) rather than 'estar hambriento' (để be hungry). This is an example của transposition, where  grammatical structure shifts from adjective để noun.  correct fill is 'hambre' (hunger),  noun form.
q_gram_c2_11_001.hint: Spanish expresses states của being with 'tener + noun' rather than 'ser/estar + adjective'

q_gram_c2_11_002.question: La directora ___ una rueda de prensa para desmentir los rumores. (English source: ' director held a press conference để deny  rumors.')
q_gram_c2_11_002.explanation: English 'để hold a press conference' translates để 'convocar una rueda de prensa' trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha, not  literal 'sostener' hoặc 'tener'. This is modulation:  perspective shifts from 'holding' (maintaining) để 'convening' (calling together). 'Convocó' captures  correct Spanish collocation.
q_gram_c2_11_002.hint: Think about  Spanish verb mà có nghĩa là 'để call/convene' rather than literally translating 'held'

q_gram_c2_11_003.question: What translation technique is used when 'It's raining cats and dogs' becomes 'Llueve a cántaros' in Spanish?
q_gram_c2_11_003.correct: Equivalence — replacing one idiom with a culturally equivalent idiom that conveys the same meaning through a different image
wrong: Literal translation — both idioms use animal imagery to convey heavy rain
Transposition — the grammatical category of the key elements changes during translation
Calque — the Spanish expression is a word-for-word structural borrowing from English
q_gram_c2_11_003.explanation: Equivalence replaces an entire expression with a functionally equivalent one trong  target language. 'Cats và dogs' và 'a cántaros' (trong pitchers/jugs) use completely different images but convey  same có nghĩa là: extremely heavy rain.  cultural referent changes entirely.

q_gram_c2_11_004.question: A él le ___ mucho los deportes acuáticos. (English source: 'He really likes water sports.' — gustar, present indicative)
q_gram_c2_11_004.explanation: English 'he likes' becomes 'le gustan' trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha, a complete structural reversal.  English subject ('he') becomes an indirect object ('le'), và  English object ('water sports') becomes  grammatical subject, requiring  third person số nhiều 'gustan' để agree with 'los deportes acuáticos'.
q_gram_c2_11_004.conjugation_info: gustar (present): gusto, gustas, gusta, gustamos, gustáis, gustan — agrees with  thing liked, not  person

q_gram_c2_11_005.question: El investigador ___ que los resultados preliminares confirman la hipótesis. (English source: ' researcher pointed out mà  preliminary results confirm  hypothesis.')
q_gram_c2_11_005.explanation: English 'pointed out' translates as 'señaló' trong academic contexts, maintaining  indicative trong  subordinate clause vì  content is presented as factual. 'Apuntó' could work colloquially but 'señaló' is  standard academic translation. 'Indicó fuera' incorrectly introduces a subjunctive where none is needed.
q_gram_c2_11_005.hint: Choose  standard reporting verb used trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha academic writing

q_gram_c2_11_006.question: Nos ___ muy bien en la fiesta. (English source: 'We had a great time tại  party.' — pasárselo, pretérito indefinido, nosotros)
q_gram_c2_11_006.explanation: English 'để have a great time' translates as 'pasárselo bien' trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha.  pronoun 'lo' is proclitic (placed before  conjugated verb), giving 'nos lo pasamos'. However, trong many dialects  reflexive is dropped và  standard form is 'lo pasamos muy bien'.  preterite được sử dụng cho a completed event.
q_gram_c2_11_006.conjugation_info: pasárselo (pretérito indefinido): me lo pasé, te lo pasaste, se lo pasó, nos lo pasamos, os lo pasasteis, se lo pasaron

q_gram_c2_11_007.question: El acuerdo fue ___ por ambas partes tras meses de negociación. (English source: ' agreement was entered into by both parties after months của negotiation.')
q_gram_c2_11_007.explanation: English 'để enter into an agreement' cannot be literally translated as 'entrar en un acuerdo'. Spanish uses 'suscribir un acuerdo' (để subscribe/sign an agreement). This is an example của modulation where  viewpoint shifts from 'entering' để 'signing/subscribing'.
q_gram_c2_11_007.hint: Think about  formal Spanish legal verb có nghĩa là 'để sign/ratify'

q_gram_c2_11_008.question: She made it clear that she would not tolerate any more delays.
q_gram_c2_11_008.correct: Dejó bien claro que no toleraría más retrasos.
wrong: Ella hizo claro que ella no toleraría ninguno más retrasos.
Ella la hizo clara que no toleraba más retardos.
Se hizo claro que no toleraría más demoras.
q_gram_c2_11_008.explanation: English 'she made it clear' translates để 'dejó bien claro' (left well clear), not  literal 'hizo claro'. This involves modulation (changing 'made' để 'left') và transposition (adverb 'well' replaces  pronoun 'it').  subject pronoun 'ella' is thường omitted trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha.

q_gram_c2_11_009.question: Es imprescindible que se ___ en cuenta todos los factores antes de tomar una decisión. (English source: 'All factors must be taken into account before making a decision.' — tener, present subjunctive, impersonal)
q_gram_c2_11_009.explanation: English 'must be taken into account' becomes 'es imprescindible que se tengan en cuenta' trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha.  impersonal passive construction with 'se' replaces English passive voice, và  subjunctive is triggered by 'es imprescindible que'.  verb agrees with 'todos los factores' (số nhiều).
q_gram_c2_11_009.conjugation_info: tener (present subjunctive): tenga, tengas, tenga, tengamos, tengáis, tengan

q_gram_c2_11_010.question: No cabe duda de que la globalización ha traído consigo tanto ventajas como inconvenientes que habrán de abordarse con rigor.
q_gram_c2_11_010.correct: There is no doubt that globalization has brought with it both advantages and disadvantages that will need to be addressed rigorously.
wrong: It does not fit doubt that globalization has brought with it advantages like inconveniences that will have to be approached with rigor.
There is no room for doubt that the globalization brought advantages as well as inconveniences that should be addressed rigorously.
Undoubtedly globalization carries advantages and disadvantages that must have been addressed with strictness.
q_gram_c2_11_010.explanation: 'No cabe duda' (lit. 'no doubt fits') is an idiomatic expression có nghĩa là 'there is no doubt'. 'Ha traído consigo' có nghĩa là 'has brought with it'. 'Habrán de abordarse' is a formal periphrasis (haber de + infinitive) có nghĩa là 'will need để be addressed'. 'Con rigor' = 'rigorously'.

q_gram_c2_12_001.question: A María le ___ en gracia el comentario del profesor. (caer, pretérito indefinido)
q_gram_c2_12_001.explanation: 'Caerle en gracia a alguien' is a fixed idiomatic structure có nghĩa là 'để amuse someone' hoặc 'để find something funny'. It follows  gustar-type construction with an indirect object.  preterite 'cayó' indicates a completed past event.
q_gram_c2_12_001.conjugation_info: caer (pretérito indefinido): caí, caíste, cayó, caímos, caísteis, cayeron

q_gram_c2_12_002.question: El proyecto se fue ___ pique cuando retiraron la financiación.
q_gram_c2_12_002.explanation: 'Irse a pique' is a fixed idiomatic expression có nghĩa là 'để fall through / để collapse / để sink'. It comes from nautical terminology (a ship sinking).  preposition 'a' is  fixed element của this collocation và cannot be substituted.
q_gram_c2_12_002.hint: This nautical idiom literally có nghĩa là 'để go để  bottom'

q_gram_c2_12_003.question: No me ___ ni fu ni fa lo que diga la prensa sobre el escándalo.
q_gram_c2_12_003.explanation: 'No irle a alguien ni fu ni fa' is an idiomatic expression có nghĩa là 'để not care one way hoặc another / để be indifferent'.  fixed verb is 'ir' trong  gustar-type construction. Though 'dar igual' expresses a similar có nghĩa là, this particular idiom requires 'ir'.
q_gram_c2_12_003.hint: expression uses a verb của motion trong  gustar-type construction

q_gram_c2_12_004.question: What does  idiomatic structure 'dar en el clavo' mean?
q_gram_c2_12_004.correct: To hit the nail on the head — to be exactly right about something
wrong: To give someone a nail — to cause someone pain
To hammer home a point — to repeat an argument insistently
To nail down a deal — to finalize an agreement
q_gram_c2_12_004.explanation: 'Dar en el clavo' literally có nghĩa là 'để hit  nail' và idiomatically có nghĩa là 'để be exactly right / để hit  nail on  head'. This is one của those rare cases where Spanish và English share a similar idiomatic image, though  structure differs ('dar en' vs. 'hit on').

q_gram_c2_12_005.question: Los vecinos ___ gato por liebre cuando compraron esa casa supuestamente renovada. (dar, pretérito indefinido, passive 'les dieron')
q_gram_c2_12_005.explanation: 'Dar gato por liebre' (để give cat cho hare) có nghĩa là 'để deceive / để rip someone off'.  preterite 'dieron' được sử dụng vì  deception was a completed past action.  indirect object 'les' (để them/ neighbors) is required by this gustar-type construction.
q_gram_c2_12_005.conjugation_info: dar (pretérito indefinido): di, diste, dio, dimos, disteis, dieron

q_gram_c2_12_006.question: El político ___ por las ramas durante toda la entrevista sin responder a ninguna pregunta directa.
q_gram_c2_12_006.explanation: 'Andarse por las ramas' (để walk through  branches) is an idiomatic expression có nghĩa là 'để beat around  bush'.  fixed verb is 'andarse' (reflexive).  preterite 'se anduvo' uses  irregular stem anduv-, là essential cho this idiom.
q_gram_c2_12_006.hint: idiom uses a reflexive verb có nghĩa là 'để walk' with an irregular preterite stem

q_gram_c2_12_007.question: She let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
q_gram_c2_12_007.correct: Se fue de la lengua sobre la fiesta sorpresa.
wrong: Dejó el gato fuera de la bolsa sobre la fiesta sorpresa.
Soltó el gato de la bolsa acerca de la fiesta sorpresa.
Se le escapó el gato de la bolsa sobre la fiesta sorpresa.
q_gram_c2_12_007.explanation: English 'để let  cat out của  bag' (để reveal a secret) corresponds để  Spanish idiom 'irse de la lengua' (để slip của  tongue). This is equivalence:  cultural image changes entirely (cat/bag vs. tongue), but  có nghĩa là is preserved. A literal translation would be nonsensical.

q_gram_c2_12_008.question: A pesar de sus esfuerzos, el negocio no ___ a flote y tuvieron que cerrar.
q_gram_c2_12_008.explanation: 'Salir a flote' (để come afloat) có nghĩa là 'để get back on one's feet / để recover'.  preterite 'salió' combined with  negation 'no' indicates  business failed để recover.  idiom is fixed — 'flotar' (để float) cannot replace 'salir a flote'.
q_gram_c2_12_008.hint: idiom uses a verb có nghĩa là 'để exit/come out' with 'a flote'

q_gram_c2_12_009.question: Le echaron un buen rapapolvo al director por haber autorizado el gasto sin consultar a la junta.
q_gram_c2_12_009.correct: The director got a good telling-off for having authorized the expense without consulting the board.
wrong: They threw a good scrubbing at the director for authorizing the expense without consulting the meeting.
They poured a rapapolvo on the director because he had authorized the spending without consulting the board.
The director received a reprimand for having allowed the expense without discussing with the committee.
q_gram_c2_12_009.explanation: 'Echar un rapapolvo' is a colloquial idiomatic expression có nghĩa là 'để give someone a telling-off / a dressing-down'. 'Rapapolvo' has no literal translation và exists only within this idiom. 'La junta' here có nghĩa là ' board (của directors)', not ' meeting'.

q_gram_c2_12_010.question: Después de tantos años de trabajo, por fin ___ las de ganar en la negociación con la empresa. (llevar, pretérito indefinido, él/ella form)
q_gram_c2_12_010.explanation: 'Llevar las de ganar' is a fixed idiomatic structure có nghĩa là 'để have  upper hand / để be trong a winning position'.  verb 'llevar' cannot be replaced by 'tener' hoặc 'ganar' trong this construction.  preterite 'llevó' indicates  advantage was achieved tại a specific past moment.
q_gram_c2_12_010.conjugation_info: llevar (pretérito indefinido): llevé, llevaste, llevó, llevamos, llevasteis, llevaron

q_gram_c2_13_001.question: Vi al hombre con el ___ . (mà word resolves  ambiguity của 'I saw  man with  telescope'?)
q_gram_c2_13_001.explanation: sentence 'Vi al hombre con el telescopio' is structurally ambiguous: 'con el telescopio' can modify 'vi' (I saw using  telescope) hoặc 'al hombre' ( man who had  telescope).
