This is classic PP-attachment ambiguity.  fill-trong itself is unambiguous — 'telescopio' is  instrument — but  sentence structure remains ambiguous.
q_gram_c2_13_001.hint: prepositional phrase 'con el telescopio' can attach để two different elements

q_gram_c2_13_002.question: Cada estudiante entregó ___ trabajo a su profesor. (possessive mà creates ambiguity)
q_gram_c2_13_002.explanation: 'Su' creates referential ambiguity: 'su trabajo' could mean 'his/her own work' hoặc 'his/her (someone else's) work', và 'su profesor' could refer để each student's own professor hoặc someone else's. This possessive ambiguity is inherent trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha vì 'su' covers his/her/its/your/their.

q_gram_c2_13_003.question: What type of ambiguity does the sentence 'Juan le dijo a Pedro que lo ascendieron' contain?
q_gram_c2_13_003.correct: Referential ambiguity — 'lo' could refer to either Juan or Pedro, making it unclear who was promoted
wrong: Lexical ambiguity — the word 'ascendieron' has multiple dictionary meanings
Structural ambiguity — the subordinate clause can attach to different parts of the sentence
Pragmatic ambiguity — the sentence is ambiguous only in certain cultural contexts
q_gram_c2_13_003.explanation: trong 'Juan le dijo a Pedro que lo ascendieron',  pronoun 'lo' could refer để either Juan hoặc Pedro. Did Juan tell Pedro mà Juan himself was promoted, hoặc mà Pedro was promoted? This is referential (hoặc pronominal) ambiguity, common trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha due để  flexibility của pronoun reference.

q_gram_c2_13_004.question: No todos los estudiantes ___ a la reunión. (asistir, pretérito indefinido — this sentence có nghĩa là something different from 'Todos los estudiantes no asistieron')
q_gram_c2_13_004.explanation: Scope ambiguity arises with quantifiers và negation. 'No todos asistieron' (not all attended = some did, some didn't) differs from 'Todos no asistieron' (all của them didn't attend = none attended).  preterite 'asistieron' được sử dụng cho a completed past event.
q_gram_c2_13_004.conjugation_info: asistir (pretérito indefinido): asistí, asististe, asistió, asistimos, asististeis, asistieron

q_gram_c2_13_005.question: La decisión del comité ___ ejecutivo provocó controversia. (Choose  word mà shows how punctuation/structure resolves ambiguity.)
q_gram_c2_13_005.explanation: 'La decisión del comité más ejecutivo' is ambiguous: does 'más ejecutivo' modify 'comité' ( most executive committee) hoặc 'la decisión' ( most executive decision của  committee)? Inserting 'más' exposes  structural ambiguity của adjective attachment trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha nominal groups.
q_gram_c2_13_005.hint: Consider how  comparative adjective can modify either  committee hoặc  decision

q_gram_c2_13_006.question: Los padres de los alumnos que ___ molestos presentaron una queja formal. (estar, pretérito imperfecto — who was upset:  parents hoặc  students?)
q_gram_c2_13_006.explanation: This sentence contains relative clause attachment ambiguity: 'que estaban molestos' could modify 'los padres' ( parents who were upset) hoặc 'los alumnos' ( parents của  students who were upset).  imperfect 'estaban' describes  ongoing state. Only context hoặc rephrasing can resolve  ambiguity.
q_gram_c2_13_006.conjugation_info: estar (pretérito imperfecto): estaba, estabas, estaba, estábamos, estabais, estaban

q_gram_c2_13_007.question: La profesora habló con ___ estudiante en su despacho. (article mà preserves maximum ambiguity)
q_gram_c2_13_007.explanation: 'La profesora habló con el estudiante en su despacho' contains double ambiguity: (1) 'su despacho' could be  professor's office hoặc  student's office (possessive ambiguity), và (2) 'en su despacho' could modify 'habló' (where  conversation took place) hoặc 'el estudiante' ( student who is trong  office).  mạo từ xác định 'el' maximizes this ambiguity.

q_gram_c2_13_008.question: I told my brother mà his wife called him. (Translate để preserve  pronominal ambiguity inherent trong  Spanish version.)
q_gram_c2_13_008.correct: Le dije a mi hermano que su esposa lo llamó.
wrong: Dije a mi hermano que la esposa de él lo llamó.
Le dije a mi hermano que su mujer le había llamado.
Le conté a mi hermano que su esposa lo había telefoneado.
q_gram_c2_13_008.explanation: translation 'Le dije a mi hermano que su esposa lo llamó' preserves  referential ambiguity của 'su' (his/my?) và 'lo' (him = my brother? hoặc someone else?). Using 'la esposa de él' would disambiguate  possessive, losing  natural ambiguity.  preterite 'llamó' matches  simple past tense.

q_gram_c2_13_009.question: María no ___ que todos los candidatos fueran competentes. (creer, pretérito imperfecto — this creates scope ambiguity between negation và  universal quantifier)
q_gram_c2_13_009.explanation: 'María no creía que todos los candidatos fueran competentes' has scope ambiguity: (1) María believed not all were competent (partial negation: some were, some weren't), hoặc (2) María didn't hold  belief mà all were competent (she had no opinion).  imperfect 'creía' describes her ongoing state của belief, và  subjunctive 'fueran' is triggered by  negated belief verb.
q_gram_c2_13_009.conjugation_info: creer (pretérito imperfecto): creía, creías, creía, creíamos, creíais, creían

q_gram_c2_13_010.question: El policía detuvo al sospechoso en su coche.
q_gram_c2_13_010.correct: The police officer detained the suspect in his car. (Ambiguous: whose car — the officer's or the suspect's?)
wrong: The police officer stopped the suspect who was in the car. (Unambiguous: the suspect was in the car.)
The police officer was detained by the suspect in a car. (Passive reading: the suspect detained the officer.)
The officer stopped his own suspect inside the vehicle. (Unambiguous: the officer's own car.)
q_gram_c2_13_010.explanation: 'En su coche' creates possessive ambiguity: 'su' could refer để  officer's car hoặc  suspect's car. Additionally, 'en su coche' could be an adverbial modifier của 'detuvo' (where  arrest happened) hoặc a postmodifier của 'al sospechoso' ( suspect who was trong  car).  correct translation preserves both layers của ambiguity.

q_gram_c2_14_001.question: En el presente estudio se ___ las variables que inciden en el rendimiento académico. (analizar, present indicative, impersonal 'se')
q_gram_c2_14_001.explanation: Academic Spanish uses impersonal 'se' constructions để maintain objectivity. Since 'las variables' is số nhiều,  verb must agree: 'se analizan las variables'.  present tense is standard cho describing  scope và methodology của  current study.
q_gram_c2_14_001.conjugation_info: analizar (present): analizo, analizas, analiza, analizamos, analizáis, analizan

q_gram_c2_14_002.question: Los datos ___ recopilados mediante una encuesta diseñada ad hoc para esta investigación.
q_gram_c2_14_002.explanation: Academic writing uses  passive voice with 'ser + past participle' để emphasize  process over  agent. 'Los datos fueron recopilados' ( data were collected) uses  preterite passive vì data collection was a completed past action. 'Estuvieron recopilados' would incorrectly describe a resulting state rather than an action.
q_gram_c2_14_002.hint: Use  preterite của 'ser' để form  passive voice cho a completed past action

q_gram_c2_14_003.question: Cabe ___ que los resultados podrían verse afectados por el tamaño reducido de la muestra.
q_gram_c2_14_003.explanation: 'Cabe señalar que...' (it should be noted mà / nó là worth pointing out mà) is a fixed hedging expression trong academic Spanish. 'Caber' + infinitive is an impersonal construction used để introduce observations hoặc caveats. Only  infinitive form follows 'cabe' trong this structure.
q_gram_c2_14_003.hint: verb 'caber' takes an infinitive complement trong this fixed academic expression

q_gram_c2_14_004.question: What is the function of nominalization in academic Spanish, as in 'la obtención de resultados' instead of 'obtener resultados'?
q_gram_c2_14_004.correct: It converts verbs into nouns to create more formal, impersonal, and information-dense prose typical of scientific writing
wrong: It simplifies complex ideas by replacing long verb phrases with shorter noun equivalents
It is primarily a stylistic choice with no functional difference from using verb phrases
It makes texts more accessible to non-specialist readers by eliminating technical verb forms
q_gram_c2_14_004.explanation: Nominalization (turning verbs into nouns: obtener → la obtención) is a hallmark của academic register trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha. It serves multiple functions: increasing information density, enabling impersonal expression, allowing noun phrases để serve as grammatical subjects, và creating  formal tone expected trong scholarly writing.

q_gram_c2_14_005.question: Los resultados ___ sugerir que existe una correlación significativa entre ambas variables. (parecer, present indicative, hedging)
q_gram_c2_14_005.explanation: 'Parecer + infinitive' is a key hedging device trong academic Spanish, softening claims để avoid categorical assertions. 'Los resultados parecen sugerir' ( results seem để suggest) is doubly hedged — both 'parecen' và 'sugerir' attenuate  claim.  số nhiều 'parecen' agrees with 'los resultados'.
q_gram_c2_14_005.conjugation_info: parecer (present): parezco, pareces, parece, parecemos, parecéis, parecen

q_gram_c2_14_006.question: A partir de los hallazgos, se ___ la necesidad de ampliar el estudio a una población más diversa.
q_gram_c2_14_006.explanation: 'Se constata la necesidad' uses  impersonal passive 'se' with a số ít verb vì 'la necesidad' is số ít. 'Constatar' (để verify/establish) is a formal academic verb.  present tense conveys  conclusion as a current finding derived from  research.
q_gram_c2_14_006.hint: verb must agree with  số ít subject 'la necesidad'

q_gram_c2_14_007.question: Further research is needed to determine the long-term effects of this intervention.
q_gram_c2_14_007.correct: Se requiere investigación adicional para determinar los efectos a largo plazo de esta intervención.
wrong: Más investigación es necesitada para determinar los efectos a largo plazo de esta intervención.
Necesitamos más investigación para determinar los efectos de largo plazo de esta intervención.
Es necesario que se investigue más para que se determinen los efectos a largo tiempo de esta intervención.
q_gram_c2_14_007.explanation: Academic Spanish avoids  English passive 'is needed' và uses 'se requiere' (impersonal se). 'Investigación adicional' is preferred over 'más investigación' trong formal registers. 'A largo plazo' is  correct fixed expression cho 'long-term', not 'de largo plazo' hoặc 'a largo tiempo'.

q_gram_c2_14_008.question: Tal y como se ___ en la sección anterior, las limitaciones metodológicas deben tenerse en cuenta al interpretar estos datos.
q_gram_c2_14_008.explanation: 'Tal y como se mencionó en la sección anterior' (as was mentioned trong  previous section) uses  impersonal 'se' with  preterite để refer để a specific earlier point trong  text.  preterite is preferred here vì  mention occurred tại a definite point, unlike  imperfect mà would imply an ongoing hoặc repeated action.
q_gram_c2_14_008.hint: Use  preterite cho a specific past reference within  text

q_gram_c2_14_009.question: No se han hallado diferencias estadísticamente significativas entre los grupos experimentales y el grupo de control.
q_gram_c2_14_009.correct: No statistically significant differences have been found between the experimental groups and the control group.
wrong: Statistically significant differences have not been found between the groups of experiment and the group of control.
There were no differences of statistical significance between the experimental groups and the controlling group.
Significant statistical differences were not encountered between the experimental and the control groups.
q_gram_c2_14_009.explanation: 'Se han hallado' (present perfect with impersonal 'se') translates để  passive 'have been found'. 'Estadísticamente significativas' is a fixed academic collocation có nghĩa là 'statistically significant'. 'Grupo de control' = 'control group' (not 'controlling group').

q_gram_c2_14_010.question: Sería conveniente que futuras investigaciones ___ estas variables con una muestra más amplia. (abordar, imperfect subjunctive, formal recommendation)
q_gram_c2_14_010.explanation: 'Sería conveniente que' (it would be advisable mà) triggers  imperfect subjunctive vì  main clause is trong  conditional. 'Abordaran' is  -ra form của  imperfect subjunctive. trong academic writing, this structure được sử dụng cho recommendations. Note: 'abordasen' is also grammatically valid but  -ra form is standard trong academic prose.
q_gram_c2_14_010.conjugation_info: abordar (imperfect subjunctive): abordara, abordaras, abordara, abordáramos, abordarais, abordaran

q_gram_c2_15_001.question: Si yo ___ tú, no aceptaría esa oferta. (ser, imperfect subjunctive — a basic conditional structure reviewed tại mastery level)
q_gram_c2_15_001.explanation: 'Si yo fuera tú' (if I were you) uses  imperfect subjunctive trong  si-clause của a present contrary-để-fact conditional. This is one của  most fundamental structures trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha, first encountered tại B1-B2 but requiring complete mastery tại C2.  conditional 'aceptaría' follows trong  main clause.
q_gram_c2_15_001.hint: Contrary-để-fact conditionals require  imperfect subjunctive trong  si-clause

q_gram_c2_15_002.question: Habiéndose ___ todas las pruebas, el juez dictó sentencia. (presentar, past participle trong absolute participial clause)
q_gram_c2_15_002.explanation: absolute participial clause 'habiéndose presentado todas las pruebas' (all evidence having been presented) uses  compound gerund: habiendo + past participle. With reflexive 'se', it becomes 'habiéndose presentado'. This is an advanced literary construction mà compresses a temporal subordinate clause.

q_gram_c2_15_003.question: What is the difference between 'ser aburrido' and 'estar aburrido'?
q_gram_c2_15_003.correct: 'Ser aburrido' means 'to be boring' (inherent quality), while 'estar aburrido' means 'to be bored' (temporary state)
wrong: Both mean 'to be bored' but 'ser' is more formal than 'estar'
'Ser aburrido' means 'to be bored' and 'estar aburrido' means 'to be boring'
'Ser aburrido' is used for people and 'estar aburrido' is used for things
q_gram_c2_15_003.explanation: ser/estar distinction with adjectives is fundamental. With 'aburrido': ser describes an inherent characteristic (Juan es aburrido = Juan is a boring person), while estar describes a state hoặc condition (Juan está aburrido = Juan is bored right now). This A2-level concept must be fully mastered by C2.

q_gram_c2_15_004.question: A no ser que se ___ medidas urgentes, la crisis se agravará irreversiblemente. (tomar, present subjunctive)
q_gram_c2_15_004.explanation: 'A no ser que' (unless) always triggers  subjunctive. Since  main clause uses  future ('se agravará'),  subordinate clause takes  present subjunctive 'tomen'.  impersonal 'se' with số nhiều 'medidas' requires  số nhiều form. This tests mastery across subjunctive triggers, tense sequencing, và impersonal constructions.
q_gram_c2_15_004.conjugation_info: tomar (present subjunctive): tome, tomes, tome, tomemos, toméis, tomen

q_gram_c2_15_005.question: El informe, ___ conclusiones fueron cuestionadas por varios expertos, ha sido revisado por completo.
q_gram_c2_15_005.explanation: 'Cuyas' is  nữ tính số nhiều relative possessive pronoun, agreeing with 'conclusiones' (nữ tính số nhiều), not with 'el informe' (nam tính). 'Cuyo/a/os/as' agrees with  thing possessed, not  possessor. 'Que sus' is ungrammatical trong standard Spanish relative clauses.
q_gram_c2_15_005.hint: relative possessive must agree trong giống và number with  possessed noun

q_gram_c2_15_006.question: De haberlo ___ antes, habríamos tomado otra decisión. (saber, past participle — mixed conditional with compound infinitive)
q_gram_c2_15_006.explanation: 'De haberlo sabido' (had we known it) is a compressed conditional structure equivalent để 'Si lo hubiéramos sabido'.  compound infinitive 'haber + past participle' replaces  full si-clause. This is a C1-C2 construction mà combines knowledge của conditionals, infinitive clauses, và clitic placement.
q_gram_c2_15_006.conjugation_info: saber (past participle): sabido; compound infinitive: haber sabido

q_gram_c2_15_007.question: Sea ___ sea el resultado, aceptaremos la decisión del tribunal.
q_gram_c2_15_007.explanation: 'Sea cual sea' (whatever/whichever... may be) is a fixed concessive construction using  duplicated present subjunctive của 'ser'.  interrogative pronoun 'cual' is  only correct option trong this structure. This formula được sử dụng across all registers để express indifference để outcome.

q_gram_c2_15_008.question: Had it not been for your help, we would not have succeeded.
q_gram_c2_15_008.correct: De no haber sido por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
wrong: Si no hubiera sido por tu ayuda, no tuviéramos éxito.
Si no fuera por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
De no ser por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
q_gram_c2_15_008.explanation: 'Had it not been cho' requires  past counterfactual: 'De no haber sido por' (compound infinitive construction). 'De no ser por' would mean 'were it not cho' (present counterfactual).  main clause uses  conditional perfect 'habríamos tenido éxito' (would have succeeded).

q_gram_c2_15_009.question: Por mucho que se lo ___ , nunca nos hizo caso. (repetir, imperfect subjunctive, nosotros form — concessive clause with quantifier)
q_gram_c2_15_009.explanation: 'Por mucho que' (no matter how much) triggers  subjunctive.  imperfect subjunctive 'repitiéramos' is required vì  main clause is trong  preterite ('hizo'). Note  stem change: repetir → repit- trong  subjunctive (from  third person preterite stem 'repitió').  clitic 'se lo' precedes  conjugated verb.
q_gram_c2_15_009.conjugation_info: repetir (imperfect subjunctive): repitiera, repitieras, repitiera, repitiéramos, repitierais, repitieran

q_gram_c2_15_010.question: Dicho sea de paso, no es la primera vez que se incumple el protocolo establecido, lo cual pone en entredicho la credibilidad de la institución.
q_gram_c2_15_010.correct: Incidentally, it is not the first time that the established protocol has been breached, which calls into question the institution's credibility.
wrong: Said in passing, it is not the first time they don't comply with the established protocol, which puts in between-said the credibility of the institution.
By the way, it is not the first time that the established protocol is unfulfilled, the which puts into question the credibility of the institution.
That said in passing, this is not the first time the protocol was not complied with, which casts doubt on the institution's credibility.
q_gram_c2_15_010.explanation: 'Dicho sea de paso' is a fixed parenthetical expression có nghĩa là 'incidentally / by  way'. 'Se incumple' (impersonal se + present) translates as 'has been breached' để capture  resultative có nghĩa là. 'Poner en entredicho' is an idiom có nghĩa là 'để call into question / để undermine'. This sentence tests mastery của multiple advanced structures simultaneously.
